# Security And Privacy Requirements Checklist: Low-Resource Reliable macOS Audio

**Purpose**: Validate requirement quality for local-only behavior, secret discipline, metadata-only diagnostics, clean-room KRISP research boundaries, and no-recording guarantees before task generation.
**Created**: 2026-06-01
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements. Items test the requirements and design artifacts, not the implementation.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are no-recording, no-transcription, no-upload, no-MediaScribe, no-Langfuse, no-analytics, and no-external-egress requirements all explicitly documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010, Spec §Constitutional Requirements, Plan §Constraints]
- [x] CHK002 Are forbidden diagnostic contents complete for raw audio, transcript text, meeting content, credentials, tokens, signed URLs, passwords, and live secret paths? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012, Contract §Diagnostics Boundary, Contract §Redaction Rule]
- [x] CHK003 Are validation evidence requirements complete enough to ensure local metadata-only artifacts for route truth, startup, realtime-safety, no-hang, CPU, recovery, and fallback? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, Data Model §Low-Resource Validation Run]
- [x] CHK004 Are requirements complete for recording trigger ownership so future recording can subscribe only through application software and visible capture state? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010, Spec §FR-015, Data Model §Recording Trigger Boundary]
- [x] CHK005 Are clean-room boundaries complete enough to prohibit copying KRISP code, assets, identifiers, UI text, protocols, or protected implementation details? [Completeness, Spec §FR-025, Research §Clean-Room Krisp Observation]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is "metadata-only" defined clearly enough for diagnostics, validation evidence, route truth snapshots, and research notes? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012, Data Model §Low-Resource Validation Run, Contract §Evidence Bundle]
- [x] CHK007 Is the boundary between audio routing and active capture/recording unambiguous for user-visible states and future recording features? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015, Data Model §Recording Trigger Boundary]
- [x] CHK008 Is the phrase "hidden recording" explicitly ruled out in every scenario where automatic route activation can occur? [Clarity, Spec §US1, Spec §Visible Control Impact]
- [x] CHK009 Are local-only assumptions stated clearly enough to avoid accidental server, Docker, MediaScribe, Langfuse, MinIO, Postgres, or Temporal work in tasks? [Clarity, Plan §Storage, Plan §Constraints]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK010 Are security/privacy requirements consistent with the constitution's driver-first, visible consent, data boundary, secret discipline, and deletion truth principles? [Consistency, Spec §Constitutional Requirements, Constitution §Core Principles]
- [x] CHK011 Are diagnostics requirements consistent between the spec, data model, driver/app handoff contract, and validation contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012, Data Model §Route Truth Snapshot, Contract §Diagnostics Boundary]
- [x] CHK012 Are future recording requirements consistently described as out of scope while preserving a clear future application-layer boundary? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions, Data Model §Recording Trigger Boundary, Contract §Recording Boundary]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK013 Are success criteria measurable for proving that routing works while recording is off and no driver-created recordings/transcripts/uploads/jobs exist? [Measurability, Spec §SC-010]
- [x] CHK014 Are redaction criteria objectively measurable with explicit forbidden fields and expected policy/fixture exceptions? [Measurability, Spec §SC-009, Contract §Redaction Rule]
- [x] CHK015 Are clean-room acceptance criteria traceable enough to review future implementation tasks for prohibited KRISP copying? [Traceability, Spec §FR-025, Research §Sources Checked]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK016 Are privacy requirements defined for automatic activation from idle, manual readiness checks, route recovery, app exit, and stale heartbeat scenarios? [Coverage, Spec §US1, Spec §US3, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK017 Are diagnostic requirements defined for blocked/failed/fallback outcomes as well as passed outcomes? [Coverage, Data Model §Startup Attempt Evidence, Data Model §Low-Resource Validation Run]
- [x] CHK018 Are requirements defined for policy/fixture strings that resemble secrets so scans can distinguish intentional examples from real leakage? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Contract §Redaction Rule]
